title: Chewing ring rawhide & chicken | Voskes
heading: CHEWING RING  RAWHIDE & CHICKEN  12,5CM
description: Contributes to healthy teeth. This snack is also rich in animal protein. Suitable for adult large-breed dogs.
bodyDescription: This chew ring made of beef rawhide coated with dried chicken breast is a delicious treat for your four-legged friend to keep him occupied for hours. Chewy snacks contribute to healthy teeth by helping against the formation of tartar and plaque. This snack is also rich in animal protein. Suitable for adult large breed dogs.
